description: Expected warehouse state after the first pipeline run on the IBM Telco sample (7,043 customers).

olap.name: Month-to-month churn
olap.sql: select churned_count, customer_count from olap.mv_churn_by_contract_payment where contract_type = 'Month-to-month' and payment_method = '(All)'

olap.name: One year churn
olap.sql: select churned_count, customer_count from olap.mv_churn_by_contract_payment where contract_type = 'One year' and payment_method = '(All)'

olap.name: Two year churn
olap.sql: select churned_count, customer_count from olap.mv_churn_by_contract_payment where contract_type = 'Two year' and payment_method = '(All)'

olap.name: Tenure 0-12 churn
olap.sql: select churned_count, customer_count from olap.mv_churn_by_tenure_band where tenure_band = '0-12'

olap.name: Electronic check churn
olap.sql: select churned_count, customer_count from olap.mv_churn_cube where grouping_id = 11 and payment_method = 'Electronic check'
